reviews.t: I am very pleased with this product because for the price you are ...

It is heavy, made from quality materials so I was surprised to see the wheels were made from plastic and not metal. However, they work well. This is second purchasing and first one was fine. This time, I received used one. It’s got a lot of stains and dirty. It doesn’t roll wheel properly. Very unsatisfied.

reviews.t: Works great! Just ordered a second one!
reviews.x: I have used this cart at my salon for over two years and it has worked great! My husband had to drill the holes as they were not pre-made (which is why I gave this 4 stars) , which made it difficult to assemble, but overall I really like it and it has worked really well for my business. There are holes on either side of the handles which allows me to attach my magnifying lap. It’s sturdy enough to hold my machines. The drawer is smaller than I wanted, but I’ve made it work. I ordered a second on

reviews.t: Only want to spend around $120 for a cart, then this is it!
reviews.x: I see that other people had damaged goods, scrapes etc. Me? Well my drawer cam pre-assembled, which I loved! The instructions are bare minimum and not helpful. But because its a really simple put together, you can figure it out with little brain power. The only thing I wished was that the two lower boards had pre-drilled holes and the wheels could slide better with a little less noise; but, I only paid around $120 with shipping  and for that its a great deal.

reviews.t: This cart does the job, but it is extremely ...
reviews.x: This cart does the job, but it is extremely top heavy so if you try to roll it, it almost tips over. You need to grab both sides of the cart to move it at all.
Rolls easily, drawer is easy to open but doesn’t come open as your rolling the cart.  Easy to put together

The product came in a very timely manner and was super simple (for the most part) to put together. However…  1. The wheels do not roll so if I need to move this from room to room, it leaves scratch marks on my floor. Seriously, why do you offer wheels if they don't roll?  2. The shelves are not pre-drilled with holes so make sure you have a power drill to be able to get the screws in.  It will serve its purpose but unfortunately, it is not worth my time to try to disassemble it and put it back i

I don't usually write bad reviews, but I have purchased many carts for my spa and I will never order from this company again.  When putting it together I noticed that the front of one of the doors had a big ding in it.  Then I noticed both of the frames looked dirty but they are stained.  Of course didn't notice until put together and too late to return.  I now have two carts that look like they are 5 years old and worn.  Disappointed.

Bought a third one, first two were slightly hard to assemble well but fine. Third one unpacked completely discolored and dirty looking, as some have also mentioned running into. Unfortunately it was sitting unpacked since covid caused my office move to get delayed 6 months and just discovered it. But looks like there’s big quality control issues.
Perfect came nicely packed great condition no damage and very easy for me to put together.

reviews.t: Amazing storage drawer – I just loved it!
reviews.x: I’m passionate about painting and always get confused to keep organized my colors while painting. This compact and extremely durable storage drawer is just amazing; it smartly helps me organize my painting color in the sequence so that I can find them easily. I also love the quality of the trolley that not only helps me keep my painting colors organized but also so many other accessories like makeup, skincare, and manicure & pedicure products.

claims.text: Many reviewers report the shelves are not pre-drilled, making assembly difficult or requiring a drill.
Several reviewers complain about the white finish being chipped, worn, or missing in places.
Some reviewers find the cart top heavy and hard to move or roll, with junky casters or wheels that don't roll properly.
Several reviewers report the drawer is difficult to open, requiring two hands.
Some reviewers are pleased with the product, finding it well made, easy to assemble, and good value for the price.
